scope_issues: The customer also receives monthly direct debit donations and other one-off donations; each donation may need to be assessed separately. This assessment covers only FP-0316-EL.

The tax-paid condition (a3) is assessed here using only the figures provided for Elaine Carter; if other charities are also claiming Gift Aid on her donations in the same tax year, the aggregate picture may differ, but the supplied scenario does not indicate any such additional claims.

The policy passages do not specify whether an electronic Gift Aid declaration satisfies the declaration requirement in E05; this assessment treats the electronic declaration as evidence of a declaration having been made, but the passages are silent on acceptable formats.
